name: The Newest Member of the Family

meta.wiki: The Newest Member of the Family

summary: After A Short Incubation, Quentin calls the egg a magnificent specimen and sends you to Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands, to a dwarf named Agnar Beastamer. The egg is fragile and only an hour remains to find Agnar before the hatchling inside dies.

sections.title: Hurry to Aerie Peak
sections.body: Quentin judges the sprite darter egg a magnificent specimen; if it survives, it will make a healthy pet. One last thing is advised: go to Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands and speak to the dwarf Agnar Beastamer, a master animal handler who can guide the final steps of incubation. The egg is fragile and cannot manage long without proper care: the hatchling inside dies if an hour goes by before you find Agnar. Agnar lives in Wildhammer Keep.

sections.title: Agnar's Verdict
sections.body: Agnar has not seen such a creature in ages, and names it a faerie dragon of the sprite darter kind. To let the little one hatch and grow strong, food will be needed, and Agnar is glad you arrived in time.

faq.q: Who sends you to Agnar Beastamer?
aliases: who starts the newest member of the family
faq.answer: Quentin, who follows up A Short Incubation by sending you with the fragile egg to Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands.

aliases: where do I take the egg
faq.answer: Agnar Beastamer, a dwarf and master animal handler at Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands. Agnar lives in Wildhammer Keep.

faq.q: How much time is there to deliver the egg?
faq.answer: One hour. If the hatchling inside the egg is not brought to Agnar in that time, it dies.

faq.q: Where does this step fit in the chain?
faq.answer: It follows A Short Incubation, and hands the egg over to Agnar Beastamer at Aerie Peak.
